Results.ReviewText: I bought this to use exclusively as a brush cutter. I have now used it a few times, approximately 2 tanks of gas.  My first impression out-of-the-box was that it was more "beefy" than I assumed it would be, especially for the (low) price.  The tubing, the head housing, the plastic around the engine, were all more stout than I expected.  The small piece of anti-vibration padding that goes on before the handle is a nice detail.  I have a light-weight string trimmer that I use exclusively for trimming, and this unit is much heavier but because I wanted something that might last, and since it has a shoulder strap, the weight is not an issue, but rather, it's an asset.  I think that I will try to keep the brush blade a little sharper than it was when it came out of the box, but that's just me.  And I'm not a fan of safety mechanisms on the throttle, but a piece of electrical tape remedies that for when I have a lot of brush cutting to do at one time, and I can always take it off for when the added safety might be necessary (if the kids are anywhere near it).So all in all, my opinion is that it's a great tool for the price.  I'm really pleased and impressed.

Results.ReviewText:
Got this trimmer as a replacement for my curved one. It came with a few pieces to assemble, which did not take too long. However, my complaints is that the directions were difficult to decipher and I could not find the manufacturer's website or even a YouTube on putting it together. So I had to fumble my way through it. After completing the assembling, there will be tools that needs to be saved to attached the brush cutter and back to trimmer again. So keep them in a place you will remember. 

The machine seems heavier than my previous one, but the shoulder strap definitely distributes the weight. It didn't come with a sample 50:1 fuel mix, so make sure there's some handy. However, Itt is definitely more powerful than my last one and did quick work of some of those pesky weeds and tall grass that my mower could not reach.

309475184.Description: The Wild Badger Power Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. This tool includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. The full crank engine reduces emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by a vented aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The attachment capable straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube and connection point which is lightweight and durable. The tap-and-go trimmer head with easy load allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
